tenders.title: International Open Tender No.1 for Crushing and Screening Equipment and Mobile Stone Crushing Equipment
tenders.tendering_authority: State Agency for Management of Road Construction in Turkmenistan
tenders.scope_summary: The tender seeks the purchase of crushing and screening equipment and mobile stone crushing equipment. It is an international open tender, with bids accepted within 30 business days from publication.
key_points: Lot No.2: Crushing and screening equipment and mobile stone crushing equipment.
Lot No.4: Spare parts for crushing and screening equipment.
Written application required, applications from companies with accounts in offshore zones are not accepted.
Tender documentation fee: 500 US dollars or equivalent in manats per lot.
Submission requires a sealed envelope containing the complete tender proposal, an electronic questionnaire, main contract terms (Word), and technical/economic specification (Excel).

tenders.title: Development and Implementation of a Port of Los Angeles Digital Twin
tenders.tendering_authority: City of Los Angeles Harbor Department
tenders.scope_summary: This Request for Proposals (RFP) invites proposals for digital twin services to create a dynamic, data-driven virtual representation of the Port's physical assets, processes, and systems. The project will incrementally connect systems, data, and workflows into a unified spatial environment, focusing on ten key capabilities to deliver measurable results and establish a scalable foundation for future expansion.
key_points: Develop a digital twin platform for the Port of Los Angeles.
Integrate real-time data from environmental sensors into the Digital Twin platform.
Develop digital inspection tools for infrastructure and environmental compliance.
Improve operational awareness, support regulatory compliance, and guide long-term investments.
